content: दृष्ट {%<ab>p. p.</ab>%} [दृश्-कर्मणि-क्त] .²1 Seen, looked, perceived, observed, beheld; उभयोरपि दृष्टोऽन्तः <ls>Bg. 2. 16</ls>. .²2 Visible, observable. .²3 Regarded, considered; दृष्टो विवृत्य बहुशोऽप्यनया सतृष्णम् <ls>Ś. 3. 10</ls>. .²4 Occurring, found. .²5 Appearing, manifested. .²6 Known, learned, understood. .²7 Determined, decided, fixed; तदहं यष्टुमिच्छामि शास्त्रदृष्टेन कर्मणा <ls>Rām. 1. 8. 9</ls>. .²8 Valid. .²9 Allotted. .²10 Experienced, suffered, endured, felt. .²11 Treated of; see दृश्. .{@-ष्टम्@} .²1 Perception, observation. .²2 Danger from dacoits.
